data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the Syndicate showed an opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2013) of GBP 1,537.0m. During 2014 there was a net release on prior years of GBP 8.2m (net of reinsurance), though prior-year reserve releases were reduced overall due in part to an GBP 8.5m deterioration on New Zealand earthquake claims. The net effect was a small favourable prior-year movement (release), while individual lines (notably Property, and the aviation war account) saw significant large-loss activity in 2014.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 8.2 million (2013: GBP 52.4 million)
The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 8.2 million (2013: GBP 52.4 million) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end.
There has also been a reduction in prior year reserve releases, in particular impacted by deterioration on the New Zealand earthquake claims amounting to GBP 8.5 million for the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities) was not disclosed explicitly in the report. The report only explicitly states a NET release of GBP 8.2m (note 4). Per extraction rules, the gross prior-year movement is not available; therefore the NET figure (-8.2m) has been used and flagged. The New Zealand earthquake deterioration of GBP 8.5m is reported in the narrative but it is not explicit whether this figure is gross or net; it has been treated as an adverse movement impacting Property with medium confidence. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (2013 closing) = GBP 1,537.0m.
